task.title: Phase N N5.6: informational benchmark:visual-diagnosis calibration and the VD-10 per-code criterion
task.objective: Implement N5.6 awkit-vra.14.6: an informational benchmark:visual-diagnosis that drives the real N5.3 adapter through the real FlowExecutor and StepExecutor over the mock-site fusion-lab scenarios and failure states, headed and headless at DPR 1, 1.25 and 2 with the reference captured in a separate fresh launch, plus a headed reference replayed headless; measure every code against fixture truth, the over-cap and omitted-contender controls, the refusals, the cost and passing-run work; apply the pre-agreed VD-10 criterion per code; prune any failing code before N5.5 exposes it; record the results in the N5 plan and an evidence JSON. Never a release gate.

acceptance.description: benchmark:visual-diagnosis ran every cell it could on this machine (headed and headless at DPR 1, 1.25 and 2, plus headed reference replayed headless) and the per-code VD-10 criterion is reported as met or not met, with any cell that could not run recorded as BLOCKED and any failing code pruned before N5.5.
Results are in the N5 plan and an evidence JSON, awkit-vra.14.6 is closed, the dashboard reports Sources agree.
The work lands on main and is pushed without force; the L12.27 contract stays untracked and unchanged.

evidence.observed: informational benchmark ran all nine cells, none BLOCKED; VD-10 MET for every identity, geometry, scope, refusal, passing and structure check and for cost (median 383 ms, p95 947 ms, 10 over-cap runs cut); viewport-uniform NOT MET in the three headed cells and pruned to inconclusive at exposure (verify:visual-diagnosis-report 63/0, verify:visual-isolation 71/0); recall single 27/27, group 30/36
177/177, Sources agree, 30 outstanding / 374 closed of 404, 332 edges
runs after the commit that carries this contract; its outcome is reported in the session report
